title: the live Godot editor
instructions: Host commands are the Godot Editor Console's commands, run in the open editor exactly as if typed into its console: 'tree root | tree nodes --recursive', 'ls res://', and so on. Resource paths (res://...) and node paths are plain arguments the editor interprets; they are not files in this shell. Start with list_commands, then '<command> --help' or the help tool for subcommands and flags. Changes made through commands are real edits to the open project; prefer inspecting before modifying.
setup: In the Godot editor, enable the editor_console addon, then run 'mcp bridge start' in its console (or once: config startup --add "mcp bridge start"). Set EDITOR_CONSOLE_PORT / EDITOR_CONSOLE_TOKEN if the bridge uses another port or a token.

host.hint: open the editor with the editor_console addon enabled and run 'mcp bridge start' in its console
